entities.name: Ernst Biberstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Ernst Emil Heinrich Biberstein was an SS-Obersturmbannführer, member of the SD and 
commanding officer of Einsatzkommando 6. He was born Ernst Schzymanowski or Szymanowski.
